## Problem and resulting behaviour

Describe the user-visible problem and what this change does. Link the issue.

## Validation

List the meaningful checks actually performed and their results. Explain any relevant checks not performed.

## Screenshots or interaction evidence

Include relevant before/after images or a short recording for UI changes.

## AI-assisted decisions

When relevant, describe useful generated output, corrections or rejected suggestions, and how the final result was verified. Do not invent an example to fill this section.

## Tradeoffs and remaining limits

Record material limitations or follow-up work a reviewer needs to assess the change.
